create_optimizer_settings: create an OptimizerSettings instance with a named optimizer, budget, and num_workers for benchmark experiments
instantiate_optimizer: instantiate an optimizer from OptimizerSettings by calling instantiate with a parametrization parameter
run_experiment: run an Experiment with a function, optimizer name, budget, and optional seed to get benchmark results
get_experiment_description: get a dictionary description of an experiment including loss, elapsed time, and optimizer settings after running
create_seed_generator: create a reproducible seed generator stream from an initial seed for experiment plan generators
